summary: Iteration 10 (Level 1 tuning + Robot Preview modal + Combo Deploys + Boss Cinematic) validated. Robot preview modals PASS on all 3 tested robots (GUARDIAN locked/purple with 'UNLOCKS BY BEATING LEVEL 1', SCOUT unlocked/cyan no lock, TITAN locked with 'UNLOCKS BY BEATING LEVEL 8'); all stats verified (COST 3⚡, HP 560, ATK 14, SPEED 0.7x, RATE 1.0s for GUARDIAN). Modal dismiss via CLOSE button AND outside-tap both PASS. Level 1 tuning PASS — initial energy is 6/10 (was 4 previously). Audio assets PASS — all 9 wavs (deploy/hit/explode/ability/win/lose/combo/boss/bg_loop) return HTTP 206. Boss cinematic PASS — direct-nav to /battle?level=10 shows HIVE QUEEN AWAKENED overlay (game bootstraps L10 even though unlocked is L1). COMBO DEPLOY visual banner ("COMBO x3" + "+2⚡ +30% ATK") could NOT be verified — the banner text was never captured in DOM across 4 attempts, even with polling at 100ms intervals within the 1.4s window. The combo IS logically firing (energy math consistent with +2 refund in one attempt where 3 deploys landed), but deploy landing itself is flaky in the Playwright harness: page.click on data-testid=deploy-center registers as click (elementFromPoint confirms target, React props show onClick handler present), but the deployRobot side effect (entity spawn + energy -2) frequently does NOT persist. Suspected RCA: the tick game-loop useEffect deps [state?.time] cause it to re-schedule a RAF setState on every frame from a possibly-stale closure; a user's rapid deployAt setState can be immediately overwritten by the next RAF setState which was scheduled from the pre-deploy state snapshot. In the very first test with 400ms gaps I observed 4 cyan entities on field post-3-deploys — suggesting the deploys can land under fortunate timing, but the visual banner still failed to appear. Deprecation warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents) persist unchanged from Iter 9. No red screen, no JS crash.

ui_bugs.issue: COMBO x3 golden banner not observed in DOM after 3 rapid deploy-center taps in any of 4 test runs — either the deploys don't land (state race) or the banner element is being reconciled out before render commits. Since combo relies on 3 consecutive deploys landing within 4s, the underlying flakiness is in deploy landing.

integration_issues.issue: Playwright-driven rapid clicks (150-700ms gaps) on data-testid=deploy-center frequently fail to spawn a robot (energy unchanged, no entity on field). Manual/human timing may work but the harness sees inconsistent state persistence.

issues: RN-Web deprecation warnings persist: shadow*/textShadow*/props.pointerEvents. Non-blocking but should migrate for RN 0.76+.

action_items: Investigate deployAt/setState race with tick RAF loop. Current pattern (battle.tsx L140-158): useEffect deps [state?.time, level, state?.outcome] causes the effect to re-run every RAF, cancelling and re-scheduling requestAnimationFrame. The loop callback captures `state` in closure and calls setState({...newState}) — if a user tap triggers setState between an RAF being scheduled and its callback firing, the RAF's stale-state setState overwrites the user's deploy. Fix suggestion: use useRef for a live state mirror and read/mutate through the ref inside the RAF loop, only rendering via setState at frame end; OR restructure loop with a single long-lived RAF driven by useEffect deps that do NOT include state.time (only [level, state?.outcome]).
Once deploys land reliably, re-verify combo banner appears (state.combo is set — the render condition `state.combo && state.time - state.combo.time < 1.4` should show it).
Optional: migrate shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents to their new APIs to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: battle.tsx L140-158: useEffect dep on `state?.time` re-fires effect every RAF (~60Hz). This creates a churn where user-initiated setState races with loop setState. This is the most likely root cause of flaky deploy landing observed in this iteration.
battle.tsx L205-215 deployAt: uses `state` from render closure; safe on its own, but the loop's parallel setState from a stale closure can clobber the deploy.

engine.ts L177: combo retrigger guard `state.combo.time < state.time - COMBO_WINDOW_SEC` uses full 4s window; consider a shorter cooldown OR resetting recent_deploys per lane on trigger (already done L188) to allow chained combos.
builder.tsx: preview modal implementation is clean; Pressable-outside-Pressable pattern with no-op inner onPress correctly prevents backdrop dismiss on card tap.

success_rate.frontend: Robot preview modal 100% (3/3 robots), Level 1 tuning 100% (energy=6/10 confirmed), Audio 100% (9/9), Boss cinematic 100%, Combo deploy visual FAIL (0/4 attempts observed banner)

rca_of_issue: COMBO banner not observed = downstream of deploy-landing flakiness. RCA of deploy flakiness: battle.tsx game-loop useEffect includes [state?.time] in dep array. On every RAF the loop calls setState({...newState}), which triggers React re-render, which changes state.time, which triggers the useEffect cleanup+re-run. The RAF callback captures `state` in closure at effect-run time. A user tap fires deployAt which calls setState with a new deploy — but if the previous RAF is already scheduled and its callback fires next, it will call setState with a state snapshot that does NOT include the deploy, overwriting it. Mitigation: hoist mutable game state into a useRef, drive the RAF loop via a stable useEffect ([level, state?.outcome] only) that reads/writes the ref, and only setState() at the end of each frame with a shallow copy for render. This will make deployAt writes atomic against the RAF loop.
